## Où j'en suis
The real replay of 18.4M events into `events.replay.v3` is complete, and the aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 is running at 61%. We are waiting for the backfill to finish to compare ClickHouse counts and close the incident, while ignoring PR #241 since Daniel handles the CI check. (source: ses-rp-2, src-slack-incident)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 is running at 61% to restore the missing events. (source: ses-rp-2)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for the backfill to reach 100%, compare ClickHouse counts hour by hour, and close the incident. (source: ses-rp-2)
- [essai-raté] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled due to the 2Gi memory limit. (source: ses-rp-1, src-sentry-oom)
- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3` and never produce to `events.v3` directly. (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] Ignore PR #241 and let Daniel add the CI check for the dedup key length. (source: r2-09, src-slack-incident)
